INGREDIENTS: Enriched unbleached flour (wheat flour, malted barley flour, ascorbic acid [dough conditioner), niacin, reduced iron, thiamin mononitrate, — fiboflavin, folic acid), sugar, degermed yellow cornmeal, salt, miei takin soda, sodium acid _pyrophos hate soybean oil, honey powder, natural flavor.

CONTAINS: Wheat. May contain milk, eggs, soy and tree nuts.
